in_marathi.name: Tanish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift, Grace, Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tanish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tanish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘tan’ meaning ‘to give’ and ‘ish’ meaning ‘lord’ or ‘god’. This name signifies the bestowal of grace or blessing from the divine. It is a name that embodies the essence of a gift or a blessing from the heavens.
